# `stop_auto_focuse`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Cancel autofocus (method name is spelled stop_auto_focuse).

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / probable (64-bit build; 32-bit build probable) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xcc160, StopAutoFocus @0x268ca0 (64-bit build); tier INFERRED |

Local branch reads no parameters. It sets a capture error code (253), logs a manual-cancel message and calls the autofocus stop helper with cancellation enabled; stopping the worker thread can set a stop flag, signal and join the worker, with no request-supplied wait flag and no bounded short timeout. The reply is always success after that call. On wide-camera models in certain view modes the request is forwarded to the peer processor instead. Firmware 9.75, app 3.4.0 uses the relay-only form of the common relay check (it relays to the peer process when needed and runs no occupancy probe, so no 203 or 524 comes from it; READ in 64-bit firmware 9.75) instead of the 9.31 view-mode test, the stop still sets 253 and stops autofocus, the wire effect is INFERRED.

Side effects: Stops the autofocus worker thread and records a capture error state; the focuser stops as the worker ends.

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

No local error path; the local branch always replies success. Peer relay failures are unresolved.

## Example

Request, request:

```json
{"id":32,"method":"stop_auto_focuse"}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"stop_auto_focuse","result":0,"code":0,"id":32}
```
